scripts.build: npm --workspace packages/core run build && npm --workspace packages/db run build && npm --workspace apps/worker run build && npm --workspace apps/web run build
scripts.dev:worker:once: cross-env WORKER_RUN_ONCE=true npm --workspace apps/worker run dev
scripts.test:db:up: node -e "console.log('SQLite test database uses local file; no service to start')"
scripts.test:integration: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-integration-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 npm run test:db:reset && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-integration-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 vitest run tests/integration
scripts.test:e2e: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-e2e-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 npm run test:db:reset && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-e2e-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 playwright test
scripts.verify:social-stress: cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-stress-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 npm run test:db:reset && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./data/scaner-stress-test.db AUTH_SECRET=test-secret ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@scaner-blogers.local ADMIN_PASSWORD=TestOnly!ChangeInCi2026 vitest run tests/integration/worker.integration.test.ts -t "stress-processes mixed social jobs"
scripts.verify:social-integrity: npm --workspace packages/core run build && tsx scripts/social-integrity.ts
scripts.verify:collectors: python -m unittest discover collectors/instagram -p "test_*.py" && python -m unittest discover collectors/vk -p "test_*.py" && python -m unittest discover collectors/youtube -p "test_*.py"
scripts.verify:local: npm run prisma:generate && npm run verify:secrets && npm run verify:collectors && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:qa && npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:local && npm run verify:db && npm run verify:social-integrity && npm run verify:social-stress && npm run verify:port
scripts.verify:full-live: npm run verify:full && npm run verify:social-smoke
scripts.verify:live: npm run verify:local && npm run test:smoke:google
